description: This is a unit test class for the StatsRoute component in a Java project, testing various HTTP endpoint behaviors related to statistics routes.

classes.name: StatsRouteTest
classes.description: Unit test class for StatsRoute, testing HTTP endpoint responses related to statistics.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates a dummy actor, and sets up the StatsRoute for testing.

methods.name: getStatsToplevelUrl
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the top-level stats URL returns a 404 Not Found.

methods.name: getStatsThingsUrl
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the stats 'things' URL returns a success status.

methods.name: postStatsThingsUrlReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that POST requests to the 'things' stats URL are not allowed, expecting a 405 status.

methods.name: getStatsSearchUrl
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the 'search' stats URL returns a success status.

methods.name: getNonExistingToplevelUrl
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to an unknown path returns a 404 Not Found.
